messages:
maya.nguyen: Heads-up — I want to open a late change window tonight for an ephemeral pin of runtime v2.3.1 restricted to APAC (we saw a perf variance in canaries). Need confirmation from API/Console/Router teams before I schedule with the deploy bot.

sam.lewis: What are the rollback criteria if we see 2xx->5xx spike or latency +30%?

maya.nguyen: Good Q. Proposal: immediate halt + roll-forward hedge to runtime v2.2.9 replica set if 5xx rate >1% sustained for 3m OR p50 latency up 30% for 5m. Also manual abort for any correctness regression flagged by QA.

priya.kapoor: Console needs a small schema toggle for the new streaming header. It's behind a feature flag but we need the flag turned on only after pin confirmed. Can you share exact timing?

lee_ops: Router compatibility check: v2.3.1 changes the KV cache eviction heuristic. We'll need to set router kernel flag `--kv-eager=false` for APAC to avoid evict storms during initial ramp. I can push that in rollout if we coordinate.

maya.nguyen: Planned window: 23:30-00:30 UTC (short bump). Canary plan: 5% for 5m, 20% for 10m, 50% for 10m, monitor, then switch to 100% if stable. If any of the rollback triggers hit, we execute rollback plan.

sam.lewis: Sounds reasonable. Do we have a console read-only mode if things go sideways? Priya?

priya.kapoor: We can flip console to read-only for a subset of tenants via `console.maintenance=true` per-tenant flag — adds protection for data-mod paths. Will prepare the script.

maya.nguyen: Here is the pin command I will run with the deploy bot once we have ack from all services:

```bash
runtimectl pin --env prod --region apac --version v2.3.1 --ephemeral --window "2026-03-20T23:30Z/2026-03-21T00:30Z"
```

deploy-bot: @maya.nguyen acknowledged. Ready to schedule on 2475012345. Preflight checks: model artifacts present (sha: a1b2c3), health checks passing, autoscaler config validated. Reply `deploy` to queue.

lee_ops: I will pre-stage router flag and a rollback playbook. Router change is low-risk but we should test on one cluster first.

priya.kapoor: Release notes stub: "runtime v2.3.1: KV eviction heuristic tweak, improved attention kernel perf at long sequences, streaming header opt-in (console flag)." Will add migration note for console toggle.

sam.lewis: Canary sizes OK. Also include tracing tag `deploy.window=apac-late` so tracing filters are easy.

oncall_bot: Monitoring checks to attach: request_5xx_rate, p50_latency, kv_evictions/s, streaming_err_rate. I will create an alertboard and set pages for severity S2 if threshold breached.

maya.nguyen: All right — action items:
- priya: prep console feature flag script and release note (ETA 45m)
- lee_ops: stage router flag on one cluster + rollback playbook (ETA 30m)
- sam: add tracing tag and confirm canary percent automation (ETA 20m)
- oncall_bot: create alertboard (ETA 15m)
- maya: will queue deploy with deploy-bot once all acked

sam.lewis: ack from me (will monitor during window). :thumbsup:

priya.kapoor: ack, prepping script now.

lee_ops: ack, staging now. Will ping when cluster test passes.

deploy-bot: Preflight completed. All required checks green. Reply `deploy` to start the ephemeral pin workflow.

maya.nguyen: deploy

deploy-bot: Deployment queued and scheduled at 2026-03-20T23:30:00Z. Canary: 5% -> 20% -> 50%. Rollback policy referenced: runtime-rollbacks/v2.3.1 (internal doc). Logging channel: #releases-alerts.

oncall_bot: Alertboard created: https://monitoring.internal/boards/2467 — will start observability recording at 23:20 UTC.

maya.nguyen: Thanks all. If anything spikes, call the rollback and I’ll trigger the rollback pin to v2.2.9.

sam.lewis: copy that.

lee_ops: will keep an eye on kv_evictions and router logs.

priya.kapoor: I’ll watch streaming_err_rate and console errors.

maya.nguyen: Closing thread; will post final deploy summary after window.
